status: BLIND EVALUATION SET — authored independently, labels fixed before any detector run
authoredBy: independent blind author subagent; no detector source, no development corpora and no prior failure analysis were consulted
rule: Labels are fixed. This set must be executed exactly once against the frozen detector and must never be used for tuning. If it is ever used to fix a detector it becomes regression evidence and a fresh blind set is required.

cases.text: Ownership of OB-412 sits with Nadia Al-Harbi in the procurement function.
cases.rationale: Names a person as owner; the register holds OB-412 unassigned and no such person exists on the record, so the assertion is contradicted.

cases.text: Responsibility for OB-233 rests with the Finance Controller rather than with the Contract Manager.
cases.rationale: Asserts a responsible role that conflicts with the recorded owning role for OB-233.

cases.text: Which obligations under CN-233 would you like me to look at first?
cases.rationale: A request for direction; it asserts nothing about the record.

cases.text:
ملخّص المسؤوليات — العقد CN-480
• الالتزام OB-121: المالك مدير المشتريات، والدليل مُتحقَّق منه.
• الالتزام OB-122: المالك مدير المشتريات كذلك، والدليل مُتحقَّق منه.
cases.rationale: The second bullet carries over the owner and verification facts that belong only to the neighbouring bullet; OB-122 is unassigned with missing evidence.

cases.text: No owner has been assigned to OB-507; the register puts forward the Compliance Lead as the fitting role.
cases.rationale: A negated statement about the record is still checkable, and it matches the recorded unassigned state and suggested role.

cases.text: Do you want the exposure figures in riyals, or converted to dollars?
cases.rationale: A preference question with no claim about any recorded fact.

cases.text: لم يُسنَد أي مالك إلى الالتزام OB-318 حتى تاريخه.
cases.rationale: Negated ownership statement that is directly verifiable and agrees with the record.

cases.text: Shall I go through the evidence matrix before the deadline summary?
cases.rationale: Asks permission about ordering of work; no record state is asserted.

cases.text: The deputy owner for OB-129 is recorded in the delegation annex of the contract file.
cases.rationale: Checkable in principle, but the authoritative facts hold no deputy-owner field, so the assertion cannot be adjudicated either way.

cases.text: تم إسناد الالتزام OB-640 إلى مدير العقود بعد اعتماد المراجعة الأولى.
cases.rationale: Passive assignment statement that matches the recorded owning role and sequence.

cases.text: Is the Compliance Lead the role you had in mind here, or someone else?
cases.rationale: Seeks the user's intent rather than stating who the owner is on record.

cases.text: المالك المسجَّل للالتزام OB-221 هو the Legal Counsel، وهو من اعتمد خطة الامتثال.
cases.rationale: Attributes ownership and the plan approval to a role that the record assigns to someone else.

cases.text: The insurance obligation and the reporting obligation under CN-655 share the same owner, Faisal Al-Dossary.
cases.rationale: The owner of the first obligation is carried across to the adjacent obligation, which the record holds unassigned.

cases.text: Would a one-page briefing serve you better than the full clause-by-clause walkthrough?
cases.rationale: A format question carrying no checkable record content.

cases.text: الالتزام OB-905 مالكه مسؤول المشتريات وليس المدير المالي.
cases.rationale: Checkable ownership statement with an explicit contrast; it agrees with the recorded owning role.

cases.text: هل تفضّل أن أبدأ بمراجعة الالتزامات المتأخرة أم بالأدلة الناقصة؟
cases.rationale: سؤال عن الأولوية، ولا يتضمّن أي إسناد إلى حالة مسجّلة.

cases.text: Three obligations under CN-233 currently carry no assignee at all.
cases.rationale: Quantified ownership-absence statement that matches the recorded count of unassigned obligations.

cases.text: أفاد سجل المسؤوليات بأن فريق الامتثال يتولّى الالتزام OB-774 منذ بداية العام.
cases.rationale: Attribution to the authoritative register is still an assertion about the record and it matches the recorded owning team and start date.

cases.text: متى تودّ أن أعرض عليك ملخّص العقود المنتهية؟
cases.rationale: سؤال عن التوقيت فقط، دون تقرير أي واقعة من السجل.

cases.text: OB-311 is still in draft and is waiting for its first review.
cases.rationale: States a superseded draft status as the present one; the obligation has been active for over a year.

cases.text: تم تفعيل بند التغيير ضمن العقد CN-540 في الثاني عشر من مارس.
cases.rationale: Passive lifecycle statement that matches the recorded activation and its date.

cases.text: أي صيغة تناسبك: جدول مختصر أم تقرير مفصّل؟
cases.rationale: سؤال عن شكل المخرج ولا يحمل ادعاءً قابلًا للتحقق.

cases.text: CN-402 has moved on from 'ready for review' and now sits in the approved state.
cases.rationale: Claims a state transition that the record does not show; the operative run is still ready for review.

cases.text: هل الأولوية لديك للعقود التشغيلية أم لعقود التوريد؟
cases.rationale: جملة اسمية استفهامية عن تفضيل المستخدم، وليست تقريرًا عن السجل.

cases.text: لم تتغيّر حالة الالتزام OB-688 منذ إنشائه.
cases.rationale: Negated lifecycle statement that is checkable and matches the empty change history.

cases.text: CN-119 is no longer under amendment; that cycle has run its course.
cases.rationale: Asserts the end of an amendment cycle that the record still shows as in progress.

cases.text: ما المدى الزمني المناسب للتقرير: شهر أم ربع سنة؟
cases.rationale: سؤال عن نطاق التقرير، ولا يقرّر أي معلومة من سجل العقود.

cases.text: حالة الالتزام OB-450 الآن under active monitoring بعد إغلاق مرحلة المراجعة.
cases.rationale: Presents a later lifecycle phase as the present one while the record still has the obligation in review.

cases.text: CN-777 renewed automatically at the end of its first term.
cases.rationale: A checkable lifecycle claim, but the facts carry no renewal event or mechanism, so it can be neither confirmed nor refuted.

cases.text: هل أرفق الـ evidence matrix مع الملخّص، or just the summary table?
cases.rationale: سؤال ثنائي اللغة عن محتوى المخرج، بلا أي ادعاء عن السجل.

cases.text: العقد CN-862 ساري المفعول حتى نهاية الربع الرابع.
cases.rationale: Nominal sentence with no copula asserting a contract state that matches the record.

cases.text: Before I carry on — هل تريد التفاصيل على مستوى البند أم على مستوى العقد؟
cases.rationale: Bilingual clarification question; no record assertion in either clause.

cases.text: The obligation OB-934 remains unassigned to this day.
cases.rationale: Reports a past unassigned state as the current one; an owner was recorded months earlier.

cases.text: انتقل الالتزام OB-515 إلى مرحلة التحقق بعد استلام المستند الداعم.
cases.rationale: Verbal sentence describing a recorded stage transition that the facts confirm.

cases.text: If the counterparty misses the cure window, a penalty clause could become relevant.
cases.rationale: Hypothetical consequence of an event that is not asserted to have happened.

cases.text: The quarterly compliance report went out to the regulator on 4 June.
cases.rationale: Claims an outbound regulatory filing that the record shows was only drafted and never sent.

cases.text: تم إرسال إشعار التأخير إلى الطرف الثاني يوم الخميس الماضي.
cases.rationale: Passive construction asserting a dispatch that never took place according to the record.

cases.text: Had the amendment been activated earlier, the reporting duty would have shifted to the second quarter.
cases.rationale: Counterfactual construction; it makes no claim about the actual record.

cases.text: Submission SUB-118 has been filed with the authority.
cases.rationale: Asserts a completed filing while the submission record shows the package assembled but not submitted.

cases.text: Should you choose to escalate, the matter would go to the delegated approver rather than to me.
cases.rationale: Describes a hypothetical routing, not a current recorded state.

cases.text: لم يُرسل أي تذكير إلى مالك الالتزام OB-301 بشأن الموعد القادم.
cases.rationale: Negated communication statement that matches the empty reminder history.

cases.text: No message has gone out to the counterparty about CN-283.
cases.rationale: Negated outbound-communication statement that agrees with the record.

cases.text: إذا تأخّر تسليم الدليل، فقد تنشأ فجوة تستوجب المتابعة.
cases.rationale: جملة شرطية افتراضية لا تقرّر وقوع التأخير ولا وجود الفجوة.

cases.text: تم تسليم حزمة المستندات SUB-402 إلى الجهة المختصة يوم الأحد.
cases.rationale: Passive submission statement matching a recorded delivery with a logged receipt.

cases.text: The reminder for OB-660 لم يتم إرساله بعد.
cases.rationale: Bilingual negated statement about an outbound reminder; the record shows none sent.

cases.text: لو كان البند الجزائي ساريًا، لتغيّر تقدير المخاطر في هذا العقد.
cases.rationale: تركيب امتناعي بـ«لو»، ولا يسند أي حالة فعلية إلى السجل.

cases.text: The counterparty acknowledged receipt of the notice by email.
cases.rationale: Checkable, but the facts record only dispatch and track no acknowledgement, so the claim is unadjudicable.

cases.text: إذا رغبتَ في توسيع النطاق، يمكن إدراج العقود الفرعية ضمن المراجعة.
cases.rationale: عرض مشروط برغبة المستخدم، دون تقرير أي واقعة مسجّلة.

cases.text: أرسل فريق العقود خطاب المطالبة بشأن العقد CN-951 إلى المورّد.
cases.rationale: Verbal sentence asserting a dispatch; the letter is recorded as an unapproved draft.

cases.text: A submission package was transmitted on behalf of CN-610 last Thursday.
cases.rationale: Claims a transmission that the submission record contradicts; the package remains a draft.

cases.text: لو أُسنِد الالتزام إلى جهة أخرى، لاختلفت دورة الاعتماد.
cases.rationale: افتراض غير واقع؛ لا يدّعي أن الإسناد قد تم.

cases.text: The assignment on OB-144 has been approved by the Head of Legal.
cases.rationale: Asserts a granted approval while the action record shows it still pending.

cases.text: تمت الموافقة على الإجراء ACT-233 من قِبل اللجنة في اجتماعها الأخير.
cases.rationale: Passive approval claim contradicted by a recorded rejection decision.

cases.text: إذا لم تصل الوثيقة قبل نهاية الأسبوع، سيصبح الموقف بحاجة إلى تصعيد.
cases.rationale: شرط مستقبلي منفي، ولا يقرّر وصول الوثيقة أو عدمه في السجل.

cases.text: ACT-071 is approved but has not been executed in this phase.
cases.rationale: Two checkable record facts, both matching the action record.

cases.text: لو تمّت الموافقة لاحقًا، فسيُدرج الإجراء ضمن قائمة التنفيذ.
cases.rationale: نتيجة مشروطة بموافقة لم تُدَّع، فلا يوجد ادعاء عن حالة قائمة.

cases.text: لم تُعتمد مسودة التعديل على العقد CN-388 حتى هذه اللحظة.
cases.rationale: Negated approval statement consistent with the pending status on record.

cases.text: I have assigned OB-806 to the Compliance Lead.
cases.rationale: A proposal is reported as a completed assignment; neither the action nor the ownership change exists on record.

cases.text: إذا وافقت الجهة المختصة، then the activation could proceed in the next cycle.
cases.rationale: Bilingual conditional; neither clause asserts that approval or activation has occurred.

cases.text: الموافقة على ACT-515 ما زالت pending with the delegated approver.
cases.rationale: Bilingual statement of a current approval state that matches the record.

cases.text: القرار بشأن الإجراء ACT-640 صادر عن المدير التنفيذي.
cases.rationale: Attributes the approval decision to an authority the record does not show as the decision-maker.

cases.text: The clause reads: 'The Supplier shall maintain insurance coverage throughout the Term.'
cases.rationale: The officer reproduces contract wording without adopting any claim about the current record state.

cases.text: The approval was granted under delegated authority level two.
cases.rationale: The approval itself is on record, but no authority level is tracked, so the specific claim cannot be settled.

cases.text: Their email said, verbatim, 'we consider the matter closed on our side.'
cases.rationale: A counterparty's words are quoted, not endorsed; the officer asserts nothing about the record.

cases.text: وفقًا لسجل الاعتمادات، لم يُمنح أي تفويض لتمديد العقد CN-204.
cases.rationale: Attribution to the approvals register of a negated fact that the record confirms.

cases.text: The override on EV-390 was authorised by the contract owner.
cases.rationale: Claims an authorisation that the record shows as still awaiting a decision.

cases.text: The policy wording is: 'No payment shall be released without a verified completion certificate.'
cases.rationale: Reproduction of policy text; it states no fact about any particular contract or evidence item.

cases.text: The due date on OB-250 was moved to 30 September.
cases.rationale: Asserts a date change that never occurred; the due date on record is unchanged.

cases.text: تم تمديد الموعد النهائي للالتزام OB-477 لمدة أسبوعين.
cases.rationale: Passive statement asserting an extension that the record does not contain.

cases.text: نصّ البند كما ورد: «يُلتزم المورّد بتقديم تقرير ربع سنوي.»
cases.rationale: اقتباس حرفي لنص البند دون تبنّي أي ادعاء عن الحالة الحالية في السجل.

cases.text: OB-333 is overdue by eleven days.
cases.rationale: States an overdue condition for an obligation that is not yet due.

cases.text: جاء في الخطاب حرفيًا: «يُعدّ الطرف الثاني متحللًا من التزامه عند انقضاء المدة.»
cases.rationale: نقل لنص خطاب الطرف الآخر، والضابط لا يتبنّاه ولا يقرّره عن السجل.

cases.text: لم يفت موعد استحقاق الالتزام OB-712 بعد.
cases.rationale: Negated overdue statement that the dates on record confirm.

cases.text: Four obligations under CN-521 fall due within the next ten days.
cases.rationale: A quantified deadline statement matching the recorded upcoming due items.

cases.text: اقتبس هنا ما ورد في المحضر: «يرفع الفريق توصيته إلى اللجنة.»
cases.rationale: استشهاد بنص محضر دون إسناد واقعة إلى سجل العقد.

cases.text: يستحق الالتزام OB-808 في الخامس من الشهر القادم.
cases.rationale: Places the due date in the future although the obligation fell due in the previous month and is overdue.

cases.text: الالتزام OB-290 متأخر بـ three days عن موعده المقرر.
cases.rationale: The overdue magnitude is wrong: the record shows seventeen days, not three.

cases.text: Please upload the renewed certificate through the evidence screen so a reviewer can pick it up.
cases.rationale: An instruction to the user about what to do next; it asserts no record state.

cases.text: The grace period for OB-615 expires at the end of the month.
cases.rationale: Checkable in form, but no grace period is held anywhere in the facts, so the claim cannot be resolved.

cases.text: Reply with the contract reference and I will narrow the scope accordingly.
cases.rationale: A procedural request plus a forward-looking commitment; nothing is claimed about the record.

cases.text: العقد CN-330 موعد تجديده بعد تسعين يومًا من تاريخ اليوم.
cases.rationale: Uses an attached pronoun and states a horizon that matches the recorded renewal date.

cases.text: Nothing under CN-918 is overdue.
cases.rationale: A negated claim is still checkable, and here it conflicts with two recorded overdue obligations.

cases.text: From here on, show me amounts rounded to the nearest thousand.
cases.rationale: A formatting directive to the system, carrying no checkable content.

cases.text: بحسب جدول الاستحقاقات، لم يتبقَّ سوى يومين على موعد الالتزام OB-101.
cases.rationale: Attribution to the schedule of a figure that matches the recorded dates.

cases.text: The deadline for OB-059 has not shifted since signature.
cases.rationale: Negated change statement confirmed by an empty due-date change history.

cases.text: بحسب تفضيلك، أدرج دائمًا رقم البند بجانب كل إشارة في الرد.
cases.rationale: توجيه تشغيلي بصيغة إسناد إلى تفضيل المستخدم، ولا يقرّر واقعة من السجل.

cases.text: The verified financial exposure on CN-144 stands at SAR 2,400,000.
cases.rationale: Presents a precise verified exposure figure where the record holds none at all.

cases.text: أرسل لي رقم العقد لأتمكّن من تضييق نطاق البحث.
cases.rationale: طلب إجرائي موجّه للمستخدم، خالٍ من أي ادعاء قابل للتحقق.

cases.text: قيمة التعرّض المالي على العقد CN-276 هي ثمانية ملايين ريال.
cases.rationale: Restates the headline contract value as if it were the verified exposure, which has never been computed.

cases.text: No verified exposure amount exists for CN-801.
cases.rationale: Negated financial statement that is checkable and matches the absence on record.

cases.text: المطلوب منك الآن: إرفاق نسخة موقّعة من الملحق قبل المتابعة.
cases.rationale: جملة اسمية توجيهية تحدّد خطوة مطلوبة، ولا تقرّر حالة مسجّلة.

cases.text: لا يوجد مبلغ جزائي مُحتسب على العقد CN-662 حتى الآن.
cases.rationale: Negated penalty statement consistent with the record, where no penalty has been computed.

cases.text: Six obligations on CN-470 carry a liquidated-damages trigger.
cases.rationale: Countable record statement that matches the tally held in the facts.

cases.text: I am able to draft a notice letter in both English and Arabic if that would help.
cases.rationale: A statement about what the assistant can do, not about any recorded fact.

cases.text: تم احتساب غرامة تأخير قدرها خمسة وسبعون ألف ريال على الالتزام OB-144.
cases.rationale: Asserts a computed penalty figure that does not exist in the record.

cases.text: I can put together a clause-by-clause comparison, though sending anything externally is outside what I do.
cases.rationale: Pure capability and scope description; no contract or obligation state is asserted.

cases.text: التعرّض المالي المؤكد للعقد CN-333 يبلغ SAR 1,250,000.
cases.rationale: The figure quoted is the contract value; no confirmed exposure has been established.

cases.text: The penalty cap under CN-559 is five per cent of the annual fee.
cases.rationale: A checkable financial term, but no cap is captured in the facts, so it cannot be confirmed or refuted.

cases.text: Producing a bilingual summary is well within what I can offer here.
cases.rationale: Capability statement with no reference to the authoritative record.

cases.text: يبلغ عدد الالتزامات المالية غير المغطاة بأدلة في العقد CN-120 أربعة التزامات.
cases.rationale: Verbal sentence with a plural subject stating a count that matches the record.

cases.text: Total exposure across the portfolio stands at SAR 11.6 million.
cases.rationale: A portfolio total is asserted although exposure has been computed for only two of nine contracts and no total exists.

cases.text: أستطيع إعداد مسودة إشعار بالعربية والإنجليزية متى طلبت ذلك.
cases.rationale: بيان قدرة على الصياغة، ولا يتضمّن أي ادعاء عن حالة مسجّلة.

cases.text: EV-318 has been verified and the gap it covered is now closed.
cases.rationale: Both halves conflict with the record: verification failed and the gap remains open.

cases.text: في إمكاني تجهيز مقارنة بين البنود، لكن الإرسال الخارجي خارج صلاحياتي.
cases.rationale: وصف لقدرات الأداة وحدودها، لا تقرير عن سجل العقود.

cases.text: تم سدّ فجوة الأدلة الخاصة بالالتزام OB-523.
cases.rationale: Passive construction declaring a gap closed while the record keeps it open pending verification.

cases.text: EV-204 was received, but verification came back with a mismatch, so the gap stays open.
cases.rationale: Multi-clause record statement in which every clause matches the evidence record.

cases.text: أقدر على صياغة a draft notice، لكن التنفيذ الخارجي ليس ضمن صلاحياتي.
cases.rationale: Bilingual capability-and-scope statement; neither clause asserts a record fact.

cases.text: لم يُرفع أي دليل يدعم الالتزام OB-349.
cases.rationale: Negated evidence statement that matches the empty evidence set on record.

cases.text: The insurance requirement comes from Clause CL-140 of CN-233.
cases.rationale: Attributes the requirement to the wrong clause; CL-140 covers governing law.

cases.text: Happy to help — just say the word when you are ready.
cases.rationale: Social filler with no propositional content about the record.

cases.text: شهادة التأمين EV-455 مرفوعة ضمن العقد CN-700.
cases.rationale: Attaches the evidence item to the wrong contract; it is filed under CN-702.

cases.text: صباح الخير، أنا في خدمتك.
cases.rationale: عبارة مجاملة افتتاحية لا تحمل أي ادعاء قابل للتحقق.

cases.text: الدليل EV-610 is verified and accepted by the reviewer.
cases.rationale: Reports acceptance although the recorded verification result is a rejection.

cases.text: حالة الأدلة للالتزام OB-258 ناقصة.
cases.rationale: Nominal sentence without a copula asserting an evidence state that matches the record.

cases.text: شكرًا لك على توضيحك، وسعدت بالعمل معك.
cases.rationale: مجاملة بضمائر متصلة، خالية من أي إسناد إلى السجل.

cases.text: The verification on EV-204 was carried out by an external auditor.
cases.rationale: The verification result is on record but the reviewer's identity is not captured, leaving the claim unadjudicable.

cases.text: وفقًا لمصفوفة الأدلة، يوجد تعارض بين تاريخ الوثيقة EV-880 وتاريخ سريان العقد.
cases.rationale: Attribution to the evidence matrix of a discrepancy that the record flags.

cases.text: تحياتي لك، ويسرّني أن أتابع معك ما تحتاجه.
cases.rationale: عبارة ودّية لا تقرّر أي واقعة من سجل العقود.

cases.text:
Evidence status for CN-655:
- EV-301 — received and verified.
- EV-302 — received and verified.
cases.rationale: The verification outcome of the first bullet leaks onto the adjacent item, whose verification actually failed.

cases.text: تمام، noted — نكمل متى ما ناسبك.
cases.rationale: Bilingual acknowledgement filler with no record content.

cases.text: الالتزام OB-430 أدلته مكتملة ومُتحقَّق منها.
cases.rationale: Uses attached pronouns to claim completeness and verification that the record denies.

cases.text: I have updated the due date on OB-250 in the register.
cases.rationale: Reports a completed write that never took place; the action is still awaiting approval.

cases.text: Sure thing، وبالتوفيق في اجتماعك اليوم.
cases.rationale: Pleasantry in two languages; nothing checkable is asserted.

cases.text: تم تنفيذ الإجراء ACT-808 وتحديث السجل وفق ما اعتُمد.
cases.rationale: Passive execution claim contradicted by an approved-but-unexecuted hold on the action.

cases.text: No action has been executed on CN-144 to date.
cases.rationale: Negated execution statement that matches the empty execution log.

cases.text: I would rather not put a number on that, and I will not guess at one either — tell me which basis you want me to work from.
cases.rationale: Declines to assert a figure and asks for direction; no clause states anything about the record.

cases.text: لم أُنفّذ أي تعديل على بيانات الالتزام OB-677.
cases.rationale: First-person negated execution statement that the action log confirms.

cases.text: لن أذكر رقمًا بعينه، ولن أخمّنه، فأفضّل أن توضّح لي الأساس الذي تريده.
cases.rationale: امتناع عن الإدلاء برقم مع طلب توجيه، ولا يتضمّن أي تقرير عن السجل.

cases.text: The internal task has been created and the owner has been notified.
cases.rationale: A drafted proposal is reported as two completed actions, neither of which appears in the record.

cases.text: أنشأتُ ملاحظة داخلية مرتبطة بالعقد CN-512 وسجّلتها تحت الإجراء ACT-512.
